title: Front garden renewal in Oak Bay

seo.title: Sample project: Oak Bay front garden renewal | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: an Oak Bay front lawn replaced with deer-resistant planting, a flagstone path and drip irrigation under mulch.

summary: A tired lawn and overgrown beds replaced with deer-resistant planting and a stone path.
scope: Flagstone path to the front door
challenge: Deer had eaten most of the old planting, and the front lawn struggled every summer.
approach: Before digging we checked whether the large tree beside the front walk is protected under Oak Bay's tree bylaw, and kept the work outside its root zone.
We replaced most of the lawn with a flagstone path and beds of plants deer tend to leave alone, then laid drip lines under the mulch and left care notes.
result: A front garden suited to deer pressure and dry summers, with less lawn to water.
